bio_en: Abraham Hovakimian, known as Abraham Khan Bakhtiari, devoted himself from his youth to every front where the Armenian revolution called. He received his baptism of fire in the Armenian-Tatar clashes in the Caucasus and went through persecution, prison and exile. He later lived in Iran, where he was honoured by the ARF for his service. He died in the No. 1 military hospital in Tehran on the night of 14 November 1963 after a short illness.
